summary: This concise 4-page manuscript presents a machine-checked Lean 4.35.0 formalization (18 theorems, zero external dependencies, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 6 zero-axiom theorems) and a pure-stdlib exact-rational certificate verifier (HYPERGRAPH-BLOWUP-CERT-1.0) covering the finite combinatorial, link-copying, pattern-entropy, distinct-vertex union-bound, and Corollary 3 density core of Mubayi's November 2026 hypergraph blow-up theorem (arXiv:2611.33108). All algebraic identities, inequality chains, blow-up edge counts, Corollary 3 rational bounds, bit-width figures, and table/plot summaries visible in the PDF are mathematically sound and internally consistent, and the paper is candid about scoping out real-analytic integrals, asymptotic supersaturation, and probabilistic bounds. Its primary limitation is that only finite, fixed-parameter slices are formalized and exact Lean theorem statements and certificates remain in the external repository rather than in a manuscript appendix.
weaknesses: The Lean 4 formalization covers fixed-parameter finite instantiations (3- and 4-partite link-copying collapse; Corollary 3 cleared inequalities for k=3,4) and cleared integer/rational lemmas rather than an arbitrary-(h,k) inductive formalization or end-to-end proof of Theorem 1 and Corollaries 2-3 of [6].

Self-contained auditability from the PDF alone is limited because the Lean theorem statements (types/quantifiers), the exact definitions of the 60 red-team forgery tests, and the explicit Mode 1/Mode 4 finite hypergraph witnesses are hosted externally rather than included in an appendix.
Minor notational compression in Section 1 (unwritten definition of rho(J) and p, and mixing external equation numbers Eq. (10)/(12) from [6] with internal Eq. (1)/(2)).
